title: Assess how mature product practice is
summary: Use a simple framework to see where product practice is strong and where it is weak. It gives you a baseline to measure progress against.

beginner: Choose a simple framework of product skills and practices.
Score current practice for each area, using your interview themes.
Ask a few PMs to self-assess against the same framework.
Pick the two or three areas that matter most.
intermediate: Use a recognised role framework to describe skills by level.
Look at how teams work, not just individual skills.
Record the baseline so you can measure change later.
experienced: Assess maturity across many teams and spot patterns.
Separate skill gaps from problems in the operating model.
Share the baseline with leaders honestly.

toolExamples.google-docs: Score each practice area in a shared sheet.
toolExamples.miro: Show the baseline as a simple heat map.

pitfalls: A framework so detailed nobody uses it
